# tScrub

> tScrub is an open ITAD (IT asset disposition) platform built for compliance. It erases NVMe, SATA, and SCSI drives to NIST 800-88 Clear, Purge, and Destroy levels and produces a verifiable, signed chain-of-custody report — while triaging and grading every machine it boots on (hardware profile, battery health, display, and MDM or BIOS lock status) with a printable diagnostics report. Boot the ready-to-go appliance image from USB or PXE on hardware you already own.

## Pages

- [Home](https://tscrub.com/): Overview, value proposition, features, and audiences.
- [Compliance](https://tscrub.com/compliance): How each wipe method maps to NIST 800-88 Clear, Purge, and Destroy, with GDPR/HIPAA/ISO 27001 reporting.
- [Pricing](https://tscrub.com/pricing): Free licence, Pay-as-you-go £3/device, Team £99 (100 credits), Enterprise £399 (500 credits); the Windows Autopilot (MDM) check is a paid feature (1 credit per check) — free licences are self-serve; paid licences are issued by tScrub.
- [Download](https://tscrub.com/download): The bootable appliance ISO, with a SHA-256 checksum for verification.
- [Docs](https://tscrub.com/docs): Building the appliance, booting from USB (Windows/macOS/Linux) or over the network (PXE), boot-time hardware triage and MDM/BIOS-lock detection, choosing a report destination (USB, FTP, or the tScrub dashboard), dashboard remote commands and organisations, and verifying signed reports.
- [Resources](https://tscrub.com/resources): Data erasure guides — standards, drive types, wipe methods, certificates of destruction, and a buyer's guide.
- [FAQ](https://tscrub.com/faq): Certification, running on your own hardware, and edge-case drive handling.
- [Certificates](https://tscrub.com/dashboard/certificates): Upload reports on the Drives page, then select a Chain of Custody ID to generate one consolidated, printable Certificate of Destruction per job, and manage every certificate on your account.
- [Devices](https://tscrub.com/dashboard/devices): Every machine that has booted tScrub — hardware profile (display, battery, CPU, RAM, BIOS, TPM, Secure Boot), MDM and BIOS lock status, online presence and LAN IP, and a printable ITAD diagnostics report PDF per device.
- [Drives](https://tscrub.com/dashboard/drives): Upload reports and view erasure and pre/post-wipe SMART data for every drive — each drive's reports are listed under it, uploaded manually or pushed from an appliance.
- [Contact](https://tscrub.com/contact): Sales, support, and compliance enquiries.

## Key facts

- Supports NVMe (crypto, block, overwrite sanitise + format fallback), ATA (enhanced/standard secure erase), and SCSI sanitise.
- Removes HPA/DCO hidden areas before erasing (full native capacity) and verifies the wipe by re-reading sample sectors (sampled by default, full read-back opt-in).
- Handles SED/OPAL drives via PSID revert and detects BIOS Block SID lockdown (0x4286).
- Hardware triage & grading at boot: display panel (EDID), battery health/capacity, CPU spec, DIMMs, board serial, BIOS, TPM, Secure Boot, MACs, and storage controllers.
- One-touch Windows Autopilot MDM check, BIOS lock report, and remote BIOS unlock from the dashboard.
- Printable two-page ITAD diagnostics report PDF per device (machine summary + storage inventory) from the Devices tab.
- Opt-in hardware self-tests (CPU arithmetic + per-drive short self-test).
- Every report carries a report_id (UUID) + digital_identifier (SHA-256) for tamper-evident audit proof.
- Chain-of-custody report (CSV) with COCID, system serials, and per-drive final status.
- Reports can be signed (SHA-256 + Ed25519) for verifiable proof of destruction.
- NIST 800-88 alignment, GDPR, HIPAA, ISO 27001.
- Bootable, inspectable appliance image; inspect every line of what runs.
- Triage-first boot: diagnostics + online heartbeat at boot; erasure starts on Shift+T from the triage screen.
- End-to-end loop: erase → signed report → PDF Certificate of Destruction with a verification QR (tscrub.com/verify).
- Every certificate is also issued as a signed machine-readable JSON-LD document (add &format=jsonld to the verification URL), so automated auditors can ingest and verify it without parsing the PDF.
- The customer (data controller) certifies their own destruction; tScrub supplies the signed, tamper-evident evidence.
- Open source (GPL-3.0), runs on your own hardware. Contrast: Blancco = closed, platform-only, enterprise quote; nwipe/DBAN = free ad-hoc overwrite, no signed reports or certificates.
